name: web-warm-earthy-decor-product-listing
title: Earthy home-decor product grid with acid-yellow feature band
whatItIs: A product list page presented over a dark rust backdrop with a mixed serif headline. The store shows a filter bar, a masonry grid of warm-lit product photos with names and prices, an acid-yellow feature block with a craftsperson photo, pagination, and a deep brown footer with a large wordmark.
whatItMeans: Handmade, warm and considered; the yellow band adds a jolt of energy to an otherwise tonal palette.
techniques: Vary tile sizes so one hero product spans two rows and creates rhythm in the grid.
Pair a light sans body with italic serif category names for boutique elegance.
Interrupt the grid with one full-width acid-yellow storytelling band.
Tint photography toward one warm palette so products feel like a set.
Use small metadata (material icons, tags) under prices as quiet detail.

vocabulary.definition: A grid whose tiles differ in size and interlock without gaps.
A full-width block that breaks up repeated content.
A palette of one hue family in varying values.
Using italic serif for labels to add elegance.
